title: Brews & Kings
tagline: A city builder about beer and wine.
descriptionShort: A city builder about brewing. Grow wheat, hops, and scout the wilderness for pure water and rare ingredients. Recruit a team of masters, each with recipes of their own, and turn their workshops into a production chain.Keep the taverns pouring and the king happy.
descriptionLong: Brews & Kings is a city builder that hands you one island, one year, and a small castle by the sea called Home. From that quiet shoreline, you gather raw harvests, hire eccentric masters, and link their workshops into humming production chains. When the year ends, the island prints its own beer label, carrying the name of your very best barrel.

The land itself flavors the drink: barley on the flats, hops and vines climbing the hillsides, sweet lowland apples and sharp highland ones, and springs tasting of soft, hard, or chalky rock. Rare pockets—an old spring, a sunny orchard, an ancient beech grove—guard the finest harvests. To brew it, you hire from fifteen distinct masters—from Jack the Novice's honest ale to Merlin the Wizard's wild sours and Ming of the Scarlet Palace's rice lager—each moving into an empty workshop with their workers and horses in tow.

Once running, the workshops lock into a single chain: barley becomes malt, wort, and ale; grapes press into wine and distill into brandy; felled timber becomes the barrels holding it all. Every master you hire snaps a new link into place, and a missing specialist leaves an immediate gap in the line. Because a brew is only as good as its worst ingredient, steering your rarest water and fruit into the right workshops is what separates an ordinary barrel from a masterpiece.

When the barrels roll out, three crowds wait with empty mugs: your crew drinks every Saturday night, the Merchant's ship docks every Wednesday paying gold by the barrel, and the Queen's red-sailed ship arrives every Friday for offerings before returning each season for her tax. Each craves different tastes, and pleasing them reshapes your run—a happy crew calls another master to your shores, while the Merchant and the Queen hand over gifts that bend the rules. You can never fill every cup, so every barrel you send out is a choice of who you want to keep smiling.
Brews & Kings is made by Scarlet Engineering, a Taiwan studio building systems-driven games where simple rules produce surprising play.
features: Build a city that exists to brew and ferment: fields, vines, brewhouses, winepresses, cellars, and taverns.
Recruit a team of masters, each with recipes of their own, and build your production chain around them.
Explore for what the realm cannot grow: the purest water, the richest soil, rare ingredients, and lost recipes.
Combine your discoveries into beers and wines of your own, and give them your name.
You can't please everyone: merchants, the Queen, and workers each want something different from your drinks.
Survive the trial that ends every run: a royal festival, a freezing winter, or a spirit that drains your people.
Begin again: new buildings, merchants, and challenges join the world, and your recipes stay in your book.

Brews & Kings is the studio's take on the city builder: a medieval kingdom that runs on beer and wine.
